The caregiver emphasized the need to preheat the stove, fully melt the butter before adding flour, and continuously whisk to form a smooth paste, but the child persisted in adding flour to cold butter and did not use proper heat, resulting in an incomplete and lumpy mixture; the task did not succeed.
